title: Print then return
prompt: Call print(n) to print the value of n, then return n times 10. The tests check what you print as well as what you return.

tests.name: A negative is printed and ten times it comes back

hints: Two lines: print first, then return.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.
